brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Compartmentalized storage to keep small sewing supplies (buttons, needles, pins, bobbins, etc.) separated and tidy
requirements.evidence: Four cells used as storage: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 and bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 each provide 2 compartments (6 small compartments total) plus bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full provides one large compartment for larger supplies. All are full-depth trays hanging on cell rims.

requirements.requirement: Accessible, visible organization and a flat work surface
requirements.evidence: Bins are open-top and verified visible from above in look (polar 10/low angle views show compartment contents). Two covers cover:0,0,0;full;top and cover:1,0,0;full;top create a 310x227mm deck (f10) for cutting/measuring; staged with tape measure (prop:8) and steel rule (prop:9) as proxies for sewing measuring tools. Joint bolts and end caps lock the 4-piece cluster.

requirements.requirement: Sewing-themed parts or props specific to sewing
requirements.evidence: Catalog contains no sewing-specific bins or props (find_props for sewing/thread/scissors/button/bobbin returned 0). Build uses generic small-parts storage proxies: heap-screws/nuts/standoffs for buttons/beads, tweezers, solder-reel as thread spool, electrical tape/tape-gaffer, marker/brush stored in compartments. No material, load or safety claims made.

finish.summary: Built a compact 4-cell Hex Cluster organizer: 3x 2-compartment bins + 1 full bin for bulk storage, with two covers forming a shared work deck. Staged with available small-part props as stand-ins for sewing notions (measuring tape, ruler, tweezers, spools, buttons). No sewing-specific parts exist in the catalog, so generic workshop storage is used as the closest functional equivalent. Build passes check_build with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your sewing kit deserves a tidy home — I'll put together a compact organizer for it.
Noted — I'll survey the organizer options to see what compartments would suit sewing notions.
